scope: Forward evidence roadmap for the TSV-to-device path; not a software-test summary, overall project score, or manufacturing-signoff claim.

roadmap_stages.title: Reference case
roadmap_stages.goal: Freeze permitted geometry or layout, materials, loads, stable identifiers, measurements, uncertainty, and immutable manifests.

roadmap_stages.title: Numerical qualification
roadmap_stages.goal: Complete experiment-matched boundary conditions, convergence and element comparisons, MPI qualification, conservation, and matched-fidelity studies.

roadmap_stages.title: Experimental comparison
roadmap_stages.goal: Compare global curvature and local Raman observables with declared alignment, uncertainty, tolerances, and held comparison data.

roadmap_stages.title: Device mapping
roadmap_stages.goal: Propagate an accepted 3-D field to device observables and reproduce the cited isolated-TSV and array cases.

roadmap_stages.title: EDA design loop
roadmap_stages.goal: Round-trip design identities and coordinates, back-annotate results, execute a legal design action, and report its penalties.

roadmap_stages.title: Reproducible case release
roadmap_stages.goal: Retain a locked environment, immutable inputs and results, release artifacts, checksums, and an external reproduction record.

evidence: Lamé and generated-geometry thermo-mechanical component checks
cubic-tensor, Tet4 affine-strain, conformal-region, and serial periodic-MPC checks
numerical_mechanics.blocking_reason: near-surface Raman mesh/domain convergence, experiment-matched boundary conditions, an independent element comparison, and MPI MPC qualification remain open

global_experiment.blocking_reason: the comparison curves and uncertainty record are not bundled or reproduced

local_experiment.blocking_reason: the measured curves, masks, spatial-resolution record, and mesh/domain-qualified local field are incomplete

multilevel_accuracy.blocking_reason: independent global/local meshes and a full-array reference are absent

conservation.blocking_reason: force, moment, and virtual-work transfer checks are absent

performance.blocking_reason: the retained 526,338-DOF MPI rank sweep measures one distributed model; a matched-fidelity full-versus-reduced timing and memory comparison has not begun

evidence: tensor rotation, Raman observable, mobility mapping, and synthetic device-screening APIs

eda_semantics.blocking_reason: no retained OpenDB/DEF round-trip case or coordinate round-trip check exists

design_action.blocking_reason: no legal-placement OpenDB action or design-penalty accounting is demonstrated
